answer: Spot-audit lottery stops bulk fakes: all identities are drawable. Each applicant locks 60 credits and files one record at a single inlet. Each epoch a beacon draws from a velvet bag; ten in a hundred face audit. Each drawn identity answers a cipher challenge in one hour; rented records fail, keys differ. Forging 1,000 means 100 audits and 60,000 locked against a 40,000 pool; failures burn bonds. Honest agents pay 60 once, keeping full shares.
